title: Hindi film stars lend quiet support to protesters
description: Even as many big stars have maintained a studied silence, artists like Naseeruddin Shah, Shabana Azmi, Alia Bhatt, R. Madhavan, Sara Ali Khan and Huma Qureshi have lent support to the youngsters protesting in Jantar Mantar seeking reforms in education system and the sacking of Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan
